title: SIGNAL eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools: prerequisiteFor re-chained on the year axis (PR #165 merged 53308e1e)
body: Follow-up to the G3 signal (db953071), per ruling 215b08d2: the prerequisiteFor edges consumed by get-prior-knowledge-graph are re-derived on the year axis — count preserved (3,452; totalEdges 31,911), 3,215 chains re-derived (93.1%), 237 unchanged, selfLoops 28->33 (corrected adjacency exposing five duplicate same-(unit,year) placements). Within-year semantics: same-year units chain in unitId order, stated-arbitrary, pinned by test. The value re-proof over the re-chained surface is owned by eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools; the open prerequisiteFor-multiplicity question is queued with the Director (bbe99f11).
